title: Captions
description: Word-level captions in @remotion/captions Caption[] form, written to captions.json. Emitted by max/.explainers/scripts/narrate.py:244-253 from Kokoro's word timestamps, so caption timing is measured rather than inferred.

text.description: The word. Whitespace-sensitive: every token except the first of a segment carries its leading space, so pages join correctly.

startMs.description: Word start on the narration track, in milliseconds.

endMs.description: Word end on the narration track, in milliseconds.

timestampMs.description: Midpoint of the word, which is what @remotion/captions pages on.

confidence.description: Recogniser confidence. Always null here: Kokoro synthesises the audio, so the timings are exact rather than estimated.
